name: 水花渐变梦幻水感防晒霜款
description: 水花悬浮渐变天空的防晒套图模版，冰蓝粉紫梦幻水感

styleLock.backgroundSystem: airy blue-to-lilac gradient skies #AFC6EA into #E9D9F0 for hero and accent shots, icy white #F4F8FE panels for info shots, all with a soft watery glow
styleLock.lightingSystem: cool soft studio light with an upper-left key, dreamy glow, soft contact shadows and watery specular highlights
styleLock.surfaceSystem: matte light-stone counter #E8EDF4 for scenes and a glossy reflective floor for standing products
styleLock.typography: modern geometric sans-serif, indigo #4653C6 headlines, short labels only
styleLock.iconSystem: thin-line round icon chips in a single indigo accent
styleLock.presentationRules: upright floating or standing bottle, stable scale, centered with airy water-splash accents
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent dreamy water-feel sunscreen visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of misty cloud blue #AFC6EA, soft lilac pink #E9D9F0, indigo text accent #4653C6 and icy white #F4F8FE; cool soft studio lighting with an upper-left key, gentle dreamy glow, soft contact shadows and watery specular highlights; modern geometric sans-serif; thin-line round icon chips in a single indigo accent; clean high-end skincare photography blended with airy water-splash renders and minimal infographic elements; stable upright product presentation with consistent scale; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

shots.intent: 首屏用水花悬浮与渐变天空赢一眼点击，承接水感轻薄的卖点
shots.camera: slight 3/4 angle, eye-level, close-up hero framing on the bottle floating mid-air with a gentle tilt
shots.lighting: cool soft studio light from the upper left with a dreamy glow, soft contact shadow, watery specular highlights
shots.background: misty gradient sky from #AFC6EA into #E9D9F0 with a diagonal light beam
shots.props: a dynamic arc of clear water splash behind the product with fine suspended droplets
shots.whitespace: generous negative space across the upper third reserved for the headline zone
shots.textZone: top center headline 「{selling_point_1}」 with a smaller subline 「{selling_point_2}」
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce hero image of {product} floating mid-air amid an arc of clear water splash. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Photographed at a slight 3/4 angle, eye-level, close-up hero framing with the bottle gently tilted and its full silhouette unobstructed. Cool soft studio light from the upper left with a dreamy glow, soft contact shadow and watery specular highlights. Background is a misty gradient sky from #AFC6EA into #E9D9F0 with a diagonal light beam. An indigo #4653C6 headline sits in the top third reading 「{selling_point_1}」 with a smaller subline 「{selling_point_2}」. The product occupies 50-60% of the frame, with generous negative space in the upper third for copy. 2K, commercial skincare quality. Negative: no brand logo or wordmark, no watermark, no QR code, no membership badge, no invented SPF or PA values, no efficacy percentage claims, no garbled text, no cut-off bottle edges.

shots.intent: 一秒传达核心使用感受，用三个细线圆标陈列关键卖点
shots.camera: straight-on eye-level, close-up framing on the bottle standing upright slightly right of center
shots.lighting: bright even high-key studio light with a soft halo behind the product, gentle contact shadow
shots.background: clean icy white #F4F8FE with a soft round glow behind the product
shots.props: three thin-line round icon chips lined along the bottom edge with short labels
shots.whitespace: no extra whitespace, the bottom band carries the icon row
shots.textZone: bottom row of three icon chips labeled 「{callout_1}」 「{callout_2}」 「{callout_3}」
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce benefit hero of {product} standing upright on a clean icy white field. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Straight-on eye-level, close-up framing with the bottle slightly right of center. Bright even high-key studio light with a soft halo behind the product and a gentle contact shadow. Background icy white #F4F8FE with a soft round glow. Three thin-line round icon chips in indigo #4653C6 line the bottom edge, each labeled 「{callout_1}」 「{callout_2}」 「{callout_3}」. The product occupies 50-60% of the frame, with no extra whitespace so the icon band stays readable. 2K, commercial skincare quality. Negative: no more than three icon labels, no dense body text, no invented ingredient percentages, no watermark, no fake logo, no props covering the product, no garbled chip labels.

shots.intent: 放大日常场景中的防晒焦虑，建立不做防护的代价感
shots.camera: top-down 90-degree flat lay graphic layout, squared to the frame with no perspective distortion
shots.lighting: even flat graphic lighting with a cool cast, no dramatic shadow
shots.background: gradient of #BBD3EE fading into #E9D9F0 with a soft white rounded panel in the center
shots.props: four rounded rectangle scenario cards arranged in a 2x2 grid on the white panel
shots.productOccupancy: graphic panel fills 60-70%, product may appear small at the bottom
shots.whitespace: even margins around the grid, no extra whitespace inside the cards
shots.textZone: 2x2 quadrant grid, each card pairing a scenario label 「{callout_4}」 with a short worry line 「{callout_5}」
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce pain-point quadrant infographic built as a top-down 90-degree flat lay graphic layout, squared to the frame. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. A soft white rounded panel #FFFFFF floats over a gradient of #BBD3EE and #E9D9F0, holding four rounded scenario cards in a 2x2 grid, each card pairing a daily scenario label 「{callout_4}」 with a short worry line 「{callout_5}」 in indigo #4653C6. Even flat graphic lighting with a cool cast. The panel occupies 60-70% of the frame with even margins, and {product} may appear small and upright beneath the grid as the resolving subject. Negative: no real faces or people, no fabricated statistics or UV percentages, no dense paragraphs, no garbled card text, no watermark, no fake logo.

shots.intent: 让买家代入晴天出门前的真实使用时刻，强化随身常备感
shots.camera: slight 3/4 angle, eye-level candid view across a sunlit table
shots.lighting: bright natural morning sunlight from the right at 5500K, soft shadow falling left, airy haze
shots.background: matte light-stone table #E8EDF4 with a bright sunlit window softly out of focus behind
shots.props: a folded linen towel, a pair of sunglasses and a straw hat at the frame edge, none covering the product
shots.whitespace: moderate negative space above the product where the sunlight falls
shots.promptTemplate: Lifestyle scene of {product} standing on a matte light-stone table #E8EDF4 in bright morning sunlight. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Photographed at a slight 3/4 angle, eye-level candid view across the table. Natural morning sun from the right at 5500K casts a soft shadow to the left, with airy haze in the sunbeam. Background is a bright sunlit window softly out of focus. Props: a folded linen towel, sunglasses and a straw hat at the frame edge, none covering the product. The product occupies 40-50% of the frame, with moderate negative space above it where the sunlight falls. 2K, commercial skincare quality. Negative: no visible face, no hands covering the product, no shadows contradicting the sun direction, no cluttered beach props, no watermark, no fake logo, no in-image text.

shots.intent: 用微距质地证明水感轻薄的肤感主张，替代不可验证的功效文案
shots.camera: extreme close-up macro from a clean side profile, shallow depth of field with the foreground sharp
shots.lighting: skimming light from the right revealing the translucent texture, controlled highlight, cool tone
shots.background: soft lilac-to-blue gradient from #E9D9F0 into #D6E4F5, fully blurred
shots.whitespace: minimal, the texture detail is the whole subject
shots.promptTemplate: Extreme close-up macro of a glistening droplet of {product}'s light watery texture sliding downward, with fine micro bubbles suspended inside. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Shot from a clean side profile, extreme close-up macro with shallow depth of field and the foreground sharp. Skimming light from the right reveals the translucent texture with a controlled highlight and a cool tone. Background is a soft blurred gradient from #E9D9F0 into #D6E4F5. The detail fills 55-60% of the frame, with minimal whitespace since the texture is the subject. 2K, commercial skincare quality. Negative: no blurry subject, no plastic-looking liquid, no invented ingredient names or percentages, no extra text, no watermark, no duplicated droplets, no floating blobs without contact.

shots.intent: 用厚乳与水感质地的同框对比，把黏腻痛点转化为选择理由
shots.camera: two matched panels photographed straight-on eye-level with identical framing and identical lighting
shots.lighting: identical even soft studio light on both panels, soft contact shadows
shots.background: both panels on clean white #FFFFFF with a thin divider
shots.props: a small dollop of ordinary thick cream on the left panel and a fluid droplet of the watery texture on the right panel
shots.whitespace: no extra whitespace, a short label sits above each panel
shots.textZone: one short label above each panel reading 「{callout_6}」 and 「{callout_7}」
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce texture comparison with two matched panels photographed straight-on eye-level, identical framing and identical lighting on both sides. {style_lock}. Close-up of a small dollop of ordinary thick heavy cream on the left panel and a fluid watery droplet of {product}'s texture on the right panel. {product_identity_lock}. Both panels sit on clean white #FFFFFF with a thin divider, even soft studio light and soft contact shadows. Short indigo #4653C6 labels above the panels read 「{callout_6}」 and 「{callout_7}」. Each texture occupies 50-60% of its panel, with no extra whitespace. 2K, commercial skincare quality. Negative: no fabricated before-and-after skin results, no faces or skin swatches, no identical duplicated dollops, no invented claims or statistics, no watermark, no garbled labels.

shots.lighting: even high-key flat lighting, no dramatic shadow
shots.background: gradient blue #BBD3EE with a translucent white rounded table card
shots.props: a clean spec table with thin indigo rules and intentionally empty value cells
shots.whitespace: no extra whitespace, the table structure defines the layout
shots.textZone: spec table on the left with row labels 「{callout_8}」 and all value cells left blank for post-fill

shots.intent: 以留空报告框降低决策风险，真实资质留待后期合规填充

shots.background: very light blue #F4F6FB with a faint molecular dot pattern
shots.props: a blank white certificate frame with empty placeholder lines and an empty circular seal outline
shots.whitespace: generous negative space inside the blank certificate frame
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce trust screen of {product} standing upright to the left of a blank certificate frame on a glossy reflective floor. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Straight-on eye-level view with even clean high-key studio light and a soft reflection under the bottle. Background is very light blue #F4F6FB with a faint molecular dot pattern. The certificate frame is pure white with empty placeholder lines and an empty circular seal outline, completely unfilled. shots.props: a rounded CTA button centered below the product above a soft splash base
shots.whitespace: no extra whitespace, the button zone anchors the lower third
shots.textZone: rounded CTA button reading 「{callout_9}」 in the lower third

Photographed from a very low angle looking upward so the bottle reads grand and heroic, with a rim glow along its edge from a cool punchy upper-left key light. provenance.notes: 逐屏事实：P1 两支磨砂泵瓶悬浮于水花与蓝粉渐变天空，标题主打水感轻薄，底部三枚细线圆图标（补水/舒缓/细腻向）；P2 四宫格日常场景痛点卡（居家/通勤/逛街/户外）；P3 分子球与肌底砖墙式机制示意；P4 金色油滴与莲花水球两种成分展示且共用同一成分名，说法自相矛盾；P5 水环珍珠图与雾化体系栏头；P6 高倍防晒数值栏与 UVA/UVB 箭头示意、检测报告框入口；P7 授权书式报告版式与产品信息表（品名防晒霜、规格、产地、适用肤质行）；P8 参数表占位行与红底会员促销角标加二维码。品类判定：P7 参数表品名明确写『防晒霜』，全套为防晒卖点体系，硬证据充分，判护肤个护/面部护理（水感轻薄防晒霜），与源夹名无关。已剥离：LOGO 占位、公司名与授权书全文、SPF 与 PA 等级、99% 紫外线等原文数值（一律改 {callout_n} 占位）、规格与产地与日期等事实值、会员促销角标与二维码、素材站贴片水印；金油滴与植物提取两组矛盾成分说法均未作为事实写入，修护/胶原类功效断言一律不落文，检测报告框留空交付。
